_comment: Recorded compose stderr (docker-compose v2, docker compose, podman-compose, podman) and the typed cause vco_lib.compose_recovery.classify must return. The three `field_2026_09_29_*` rows are the three real failures of the 2026-09-29 update (socket file vanished, network labelled by another tool, storage-only leftover). `negative_*` rows contain the bare words the pre-v0.2.100 classifier matched (`daemon`, `bind`) and must NOT be read as those causes. Consumed by tests/test_v02100_compose_recovery.py.
